==Overview==
'''Section D''' is the second section the player will encounter, and has two areas, '''Depth''', a mineshaft, and '''Derelict''', a gray metal facility. The entities in this section are similar to [[Section A]], except their abilities are stronger. Take [[D-35]] for example. It is a abrupt and fast moving entity, similiar to [[A-20]], except fast reaction time is needed. More entities stronger I variations can be found here as well, including the infamous [[D-60i]]. Once the player has reached D-400, the next section can be found, [[Section M]]. Starting from D-100, areas will be swapped from the '''Depth''' to the '''Derelict''', and starting from D-500, it will switch back to the '''Depth'''. Starting from D-750, it will switch to '''Derelict''', one last time. After reaching room D-1000, it will switch back to the '''Depth''' and will now constantly switch every 100-200 rooms.

==Strategies==
*Most of Section D entities are either very fast or time consuming, such as [[D-5]], [[D-55]], [[D-60]], [[D-60i]], [[D-140]] and [[D-200]]. It's recommended to get into locker/cabinets as late as possible to avoid [[Claustrophobia]] damage.
*Starting from D-500 and till D-750, its recommended to save your battery as much as possible due to Depth rooms being too tall and completely dark. It won't be a problem for Faraday Shakelight users though.
*For [[Red Rooms]], you should be aware of entities' ambient due to Red Rooms' ambient being too loud sometimes, making a possibility to die to silent entities, such as ''D-60'', more probable. Also, do remember that some entities will begin to spawn passively. 
*Try to keep track if [[D-140]] is active or not in the [[Red Rooms]], as knowing where to hide is crucial to prevent dying from either [[D-140]] or [[D-55]]. If it is, hide in Heavy Lockers. If it isn't, try hiding in Blue Heavy Lockers.<!-- We need more... -->

== Trivia ==
* '''D Section''' is one of the only two sections ( the other one being '''M Section''' ) that have 2 switching rooms generation type.
* '''D Section''' is the section with the most Admin '''I variations''', with 6 Admin exclusive '''I variations''', that are [[D-20i]], [[D-35ii]], [[D-55ii]], [[D-60ii]], [[D-140i]] and [[D-180i]].
* Lockpick rooms in the '''D Section''' are different. Unlike other sections that give you a handful of items, this section will only give you around 3-5 items. To compensate, it spawns with a guaranteed V-Booster and AD-STR, which increases your max health by 100 and increases max stamina by +100%.

== Lore ==
* [[Section A]] and '''Section D''' were both abandoned because SPAWN needed to take a lot of power that was being fed into both Sections and focus it on more important things.
** this was ment to be a temporary thing, but the entities had overrun both Section due to lack of direct control.
